changes.rationale: CommandSpec accepts one confined program plus an explicit OsString argv vector, a structural effect class, bounded timeout/output settings, an explicit environment allowlist, interruption state, and expected artifacts; no shell command string exists.

Execution requires a current LiveContext and authorized EffectClass. CapturedRun records both the authority-time context/candidate and a freshly rebuilt observation-time read context/candidate after legal workspace effects.

Root, cwd, program, and artifact paths are worktree-relative and opened component-by-component with no-follow descriptors on Unix. Symlinks, hardlinks, traversal, non-regular files, identity drift, content drift, and swap/restore races fail closed.
Read, planned-write, and external-write subprocesses receive stable pre/post worktree metadata witnesses so transient create/remove and mutate/restore activity cannot become a green read observation.
Subprocesses run in their own Unix process group with null stdin, piped output, monotonic timing, polling cancellation, typed timeout/interruption/signal/exit, descendant cleanup, and reaping.

Stdout and stderr are drained as raw bytes, redacted before retention and digesting, capped at a caller-selected limit, fully digested after redaction, and never decoded as UTF-8 or interpreted as PASS authority.

Child environments are cleared and reconstructed only from a bounded allowlist. Sensitive-looking names require a context-bound secret source; secret bytes never enter the serialized environment record and are removed from both output streams before digesting.

ArtifactRef binds post-run context/candidate, confined path bytes, SHA-256, and length. Canonical JSON roundtrip denies unknown fields and path escape; ArtifactResolver revalidates live candidate and exact bytes.

findings.finding: validator/src/lib.rs intentionally does not expose capture; root integration and a compiled public API witness are required.

Positive WorkspaceWrite and Destructive execution could not be constructed through the public LiveContext API because matching effect grants are root-only; only denial and zero-workspace-mutation classifications were exercised in this lease.

Runtime proof is aarch64 macOS only. The Linux descriptor execution branch was not compiled or run because no Linux Rust target is installed. The installed Windows target is currently blocked by pre-existing context/fixture cfg gaps and HCT-CAPTURE itself intentionally fails closed off Unix.

On macOS, descriptor-fed shebang scripts are pinned, but non-shebang Mach-O programs must launch by their canonical path because /dev/fd is not executable. Pre/post descriptor, content, parent, tree, and candidate checks reject observed swap/restore races, but cannot undo effects from bytes raced into execution before rejection.

Process-group cleanup proves descendants that remain in the assigned group are terminated; a deliberately daemonized descendant that successfully leaves the group is not independently excluded by this implementation.

Regular program/artifact reads are limited to 64 MiB, retained output to at most 16 MiB per stream, environment payload to 1 MiB, timeout to 24 hours, and read-effect worktree witnesses to 250000 entries and depth 128.
PASS text, receipts, digests, and green tests remain observations only; this worker performed no claim interpretation or promotion.
